name: Jemuel
title: The firstborn son of Simeon
summary: Jemuel was the firstborn son of Simeon, who was one of Jacob's twelve sons. He is mentioned in the genealogies as part of the family that went down to Egypt with Jacob. In Numbers he is called Nemuel, which indicates an alternative form of the name.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jacob's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jemuel is listed as the firstborn son of Simeon in the list of Jacob's descendants who traveled to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the genealogy in Exodus
keyEvents.description: Jemuel is mentioned again as the firstborn son of Simeon in the genealogy that confirms the lineage of Moses and Aaron.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Nemuel in the census
keyEvents.description: In Numbers, he is called Nemuel, and the clan of the Nemuelites is traced from him during the census on the plains of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The sons of Simeon are listed in 1 Chronicles, where Jemuel is called Nemuel as part of Israel's tribal register.
